nodes.title: Law 4's open kinds fixed by main's ruling 005, section 1 (branch claude/r8-law4-open); CHECK_WAITS_OPEN is empty and law 4 holds over every served level in hinglish, en and hi. checkWaits passes in three forms: off (control disabled or gone), refused (unchanged / missed_option, no miss, no check counted), a look (an experiment repeat on the same set-up: no miss moment, no check counted). src/play/core/law4.ts: withPicks (pick: an option shown wrong is greyed until the level ends, its key carrying what its rightness rests on: kon/place draw's placement and dot, kyun-lab/dhruv's tests; typed: a number that missed is refused 'unchanged' and the control is off while the pad holds it) and withLooks (experiment: the repeat keeps its result and refusal code and drops its miss moments). Picks: todo-jodo/strips, nishana/place round, kyun-lab/dhruv, kon/place draw and size, rang/milao danger, badlaav/palat gone. Typed: kon/place measure, todo-jodo/atoms hcf/lcm, nazariya/floor and powers, taraazu/equality. Experiments: aakash, badlaav (aag; palat mark/file/put), bhaap, chhaano, jaanch, rang/pehchaan, atoms split; mark/file/sort are closer to picks but follow the ruling's experiment list (a greyed option there could tell her the answer after a 'not dry / not sure yet' miss). A sighting is a level's first check only: gradeLevel keeps chanceMis only when the pick is the level's first check (firstCheckSeq). The play cert skips law 4 for modes in CHECK_WAITS_OPEN; tests/r8-play-laws pins CHECK_WAITS_MAX (now empty) so the list only shrinks. Reverse if: judges find greying a missed option teaches by elimination on a served level (then that mode keeps the option and uses the refused form), or a family test shows an experiment repeat that should count as a new check (a set-up the key leaves out).

Law 4 over the coverage after ruling 005: n = 473 served levels per language (seeds 2, one entry per goal; lawsOverCoverage) in hinglish, en and hi: 0 breaks of any law, 0 law-4 breaks (60 law-4 break lines in 20 modes before). First screens: 2,808 (12 families, every served level at 3 seeds, 3 languages, kagaz and raat; texts, painter uses, marks, controls with disabled) hash the same before and after, so no re-cert. Gate-2 batteries (tests/r8-habit-battery-{stambh-tally,kon-place,kon-name,galti-pakdo,nazariya-tri}): every printed line the same at e2d4664dc and after (timings aside), kon/place draw's blind-chance figures included.
